style: Photorealistic golden-hour landscape, Perth city skyline across the Swan River seen from a hillside park, eucalyptus branches framing the top left
continuity: the framing, horizon and every landmark remain fixed and the scene settles into the framing shown in Picture 2 at the end of the shot, matching the first frame so the clip can loop.
ambience: a gentle evening breeze through eucalyptus leaves, distant birdsong and faint far-off city hum

segments.camera: The camera holds a locked-off static wide shot.
segments.action: Warm sunset light glows on the river. Eucalyptus leaves in the foreground sway gently in a light breeze, ripples shimmer across the river surface, and soft clouds drift slowly to the right above the skyline. Nothing else moves; the city buildings stay still.
